sorted_numpy_attempt.reason: Sorting/gathering cost exceeded scatter reduction savings; it did not address array-construction overhead.

native_stride_bug.reason: NumPy advanced-index score arrays can have Fortran rather than C layout; the initial native pointer consumer assumed C layout.
native_stride_bug.fix: max_cells makes all incoming arrays C-contiguous before passing pointers; fine inputs are already contiguous and checked.
native_stride_bug.subsequent_contract: All 1000 arithmetic/quota cases and all fixed-state coarse candidates match.

linux_timer_harness.first_failure: L1 initial direct debias choose action differed after ordinary 0.22-second budget cut off only the slower original.
linux_timer_harness.reason: The benchmark initially called the bare child with policy_config planning_budget_seconds=0.22. Production debias_entry already calls that child with planning_budget_seconds=1e9.
linux_timer_harness.fix: Use exactly the existing production child setting of 1e9 for both original and accelerated direct-debias workload calls.
